title: Add the --upper flag to the greeting CLI
prompt: This mini-CLI greets a name: src/greet.js has greet(name), and src/cli-core.js has run(argv) which already handles the no-name usage error. Add the missing --upper flag: when present, run(argv) must return the greeting uppercased. Make every test in src/cli-core.test.js pass (the --upper cases are currently red). Do not modify any test files.
